items.title: GE Aerospace To Buy Key Industry Castings Supplier CPP For Nearly $12 Billion
items.summary: GE Aerospace announces deal to purchase CPP for nearly $12 billion in an effort to bolster castings production, supply chain. GE stock rises.

items.title: Should You Buy GE Aerospace Stock On Cash That Came Early?
items.summary: At $337 a share, GE Aerospace (GE) trades at 39 times trailing earnings, which is not typically where an investment thesis begins. The bullish case here centers on cash generation instead. Management has raised 2026 free cash flow guidance to $8.9 billion to $9.2 billion, and on the CFO's own account that is more cash than the company expected to generate in 2028 when it framed that year in July 2025.

items.title: GE’s $12 Billion Bet on the Unsexy Industry SpaceX Is Trying to Disrupt
items.summary: GE Aerospace is buying Consolidate Precision Products for almost $12 billion. It’s a big deal for the jet engine maker.

items.title: GE Aerospace to Buy Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75 Billion
items.summary: GE Aerospace agreed to buy metal-castings provider Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75 billion, placing a large bet on the advanced materials needed to keep its advanced engines cool.

items.title: GE Aerospace acquires Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75B
items.summary: The deal gives GE Aerospace direct ownership of a key castings supplier serving commercial, defense, and aftermarket engine programs

items.title: GE Aerospace Agrees $11.75 Billion Acquisition of Consolidated Precision Products
items.summary: GE Aerospace (NYSE:GE) said on Tuesday that it has agreed to acquire Consolidated Precision Products from private investment firms Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners for $11. 75 billion.

items.title: GE Aerospace to acquire Consolidated Precision in $11.75b deal
items.summary: Investing.com -- GE Aerospace announced Tuesday it signed an agreement to purchase Consolidated Precision Products from private investment firms Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners for $11.75 billion.
